description: This is a Java source file containing a unit test class `Focus2AndroidTest` that exercises focus navigation logic in an Android application. The test class uses AndroidTestCase framework and tests focus behavior using FocusFinder without launching an activity.

classes.name: Focus2AndroidTest
classes.description: An Android test class extending AndroidTestCase to verify focus navigation logic in a custom layout, specifically testing focus transitions between buttons.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by initializing FocusFinder, inflating the layout, measuring and laying it out, and finding button views.

methods.name: testPreconditions
methods.description: Checks initial conditions such as the presence of buttons and their relative positions.

methods.name: testGoingRightFromLeftButtonJumpsOverCenterToRight
methods.description: Tests that focus moves from the left button to the right button when moving to the right.

methods.name: testGoingLeftFromRightButtonGoesToCenter
methods.description: Tests that focus moves from the right button to the center button when moving to the left.
